phase: engine only, ordinary Possession Engine definition unchanged
oracle_contract: Gain control of target opponent-controlled creature and prohibit its attack/block for as long as the resolving controller continuously controls the exact source Vehicle. Leaving, blinking or losing control ends the duration irreversibly. Later source ability removal does not end it. Different target controller effects may override layer two while combat prohibition persists.
architecture: One existing sparse SourceLinkedEffectView row with typed ControlAndCombatLockWhileControlled kind carries captured controller/source/recipient. Layer-two dependency algorithm evaluates source control conditions against the projected result. Actual change_controller removes ended rows irreversibly; speculative payment worlds prune their private copied rows after control projection.
expected_outcomes: successful transfer and attack/block prohibition in both seats
source control loss/regain cannot reactivate row
source blanking retains resolved effect; target blink never rebinds
newer target control overrides layer two without canceling combat restriction
sacrificing a ControlAttached Aura ends source control and victim link in actual/speculative worlds
owned children and snapshot restore retain independent duration state
remaining: Ordinary card must additionally wire ETB opponent-only target, printed Vehicle stats, crew3 and full provenance. Engine fixtures do not admit it.
